items.title: 立法會三讀通過《北部都會區發展條例草案》
items.summary: 立法會三讀通過《北部都會區發展條例草案》。 發展局局長甯漢豪在立法會三讀前發言說，政府原定目標是今年年底通過草案，現時提前一個半個月通過，反映行政立法互動良好，為北都發展提速提效共同貢獻力量。 甯漢豪說，北都帶來無限機遇也有很多挑戰，相信有很多可能性未必現在一一可以預見，所以現階段不需要追求一個包羅萬有、處理無限想像情境的新條例，而是實事求是做到既進取亦務實，日後隨著北都進入不同的階段，當局會適時按照需要引入新的法例。…
items.titleEn: Legislative Assembly passed a draft law on urban development in the northern suburbs
items.summaryEn: The legislature has passed a draft law on the development of urban areas in the northern suburbs. In a speech before the legislative assembly, Director of the Office of Development, Zhang Hao, said that the government's original goal was to pass the draft by the end of this year, which was now adopted six months ahead of schedule, reflecting the good interaction between the administrative legislation and the rapid development of joint efforts to implement the legislation for the North. According to Zhang, the North brings unlimited opportunities and many challenges, and believes that there are many possibilities that are not necessarily predictable at this time, so the current stage does not need to pursue a new regulation that is inclusive, that deals with unlimited imaginary situations, but that it is practical and practical, and that the authorities will introduce new laws at the appropriate time as the North enters different stages as needed. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: In the first half of the year, Hong Kong's property retail revenue fell by 3%, while the fee revenue will continue to decline.
items.summaryEn: In the first half of last year, Hong Kong's retail revenue was nearly 3.6 billion yuan, down 3% year-on-year. The rental rate was 97 percent at the end of September, down 0.8 percentage points from the end of March. In the first half of the year, Hong Kong's rental rates fell by 7.5 percent, down from 82% in the first half. The rental rate for commercial renewal decreased by 7.3% year-on-year, and the decline expanded by 1.4 percentage points; the rental rate decreased to 8.4% in street markets or food court. As of the end of September, Hong Kong's retail property unions had rented an average of 59.4 yuan per month, down more than 1% from the end of March. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: Police: Insurance currently accounts for about 16% of healthcare spending in Hong Kong, more than half of which is subsidized by the government
items.summaryEn: Hong Kong is entering the age-old society, deriving from issues such as retirement and health care, and about half of Hong Kong's 7 million people have insurance and the rest need government care. Zhang Yun, who was attending the annual meeting of the International Association of Insurance Supervisors, said that insurance currently accounts for only about 16% of total healthcare spending in Hong Kong and 51% of government subsidies. Only two percent of adults aged 65 and older are covered. In the face of a healthcare demand rate of up to 10% a year, the government will be unable to support it for a long time and believes that more efforts are needed from all sectors. I'm not going to lie.

items.titleEn: In the mid-term, the total allocation of retail property in Hong Kong increased by 0.4%, while rental rates in Hong Kong fell by almost 8%.
items.summaryEn: In a press release, the company announced that the total mid-term allocation will increase by 0.4% to 32.95 billion yuan per year by the end of September, with the mid-term distribution per unit of the fund up to 127.25 HKS. The decrease in profit before the transaction with the fund's holders was expected to be close to US$800 million, compared with a loss of US$1.610 million in the same period last year. In the first half of the year, revenues fell by 1.6 percent to about US$69.1 billion, mainly due to the decline in Hong Kong's rental rates, reflecting a revival in retail sales of essential consumer goods and the continued evolution of online consumption patterns. The net income from real estate decreased by 0.8% to more than 5.1 billion yuan. I'm not going to lie.
